# Load required libraries

```{r Load libraries, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(lme4)
library(phyloseq)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(rcartocolor)
```

## Prepare a phyloseq object from the PVC mealworm data

```{r Prepare phyloseq object, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load the OTU table
otumat <- as.matrix(read.table("mw_gut_PVC_abund_absolute.txt",
                               header = TRUE, row.names = 1))

# Load the taxonomy table
taxmat <- as.matrix(read.table("MAG_taxonomy.txt",
                               header = TRUE, row.names = 1))

# Load the sample metadata
metadata <- read.table("sample_metadata.txt",
                       header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

# Combine the data into a phyloseq object
OTU <- otu_table(otumat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX <- tax_table(taxmat)
META <- sample_data(metadata)
ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX, META)

# Convert MAG abundances to percentages
ps.rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))

```

## Calculate alpha-diversity and perform statistical analysis

```{r Alpha diversity statistics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Calculate Shannon alpha-diversity
richness <- estimate_richness(ps.rel, measures = c("Shannon"))

# Find observed richness of taxa with relative abundance > 0.01 
abund <- as(otu_table(ps.rel), "matrix")
richness$Richness_001 <- apply(abund, 2, function(x) sum(x > 0.01))

# Add columns with relevant metadata
richness$treatment <- metadata$Treatment
richness$replicate <- metadata$Replicate
richness$depth <- metadata$Read_count

# Create factors for treatment, ordering the treatments as desired
richness$treatment <- factor(richness$treatment, 
                             levels = c("Standard", "Control", "bsPVC", "fPVC"))

# Perform statistical analysis on the Shannon data
model.shannon <- lmer(log(Shannon) ~ treatment + depth + (1 | replicate), data=richness)
summary(model.shannon)
model.shannon.aov <- Anova(model.shannon, type = 2)
model.shannon.aov
model.shannon.bt <- update(ref_grid(model.shannon), tran = "log")
model.shannon.em <- emmeans(model.shannon.bt, pairwise ~ treatment,
                            infer = TRUE, type = "response")
model.shannon.em$emmeans
model.shannon.em$contrasts

# Perform statistical analysis on richness data
model.richness001 <- lmer(log(Richness_001) ~ treatment + depth + (1 | replicate), data = richness)
summary(model.richness001)
model.richness001.aov <- Anova(model.richness001, type = 2)
model.richness001.aov
model.richness001.bt <- update(ref_grid(model.richness001), tran = "log")
model.richness001.em <- emmeans(model.richness001.bt, pairwise ~ treatment,
                                infer = TRUE, type = "response")
model.richness001.em$emmeans
model.richness001.em$contrasts

```

## Make alpha diversity plots

```{r Alpha diversity plots, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Collect the emmeans for Shannon data
emms.shannon <- as.data.frame(model.shannon.em$emmeans)
emms.shannon$metric <- 'Shannon'

# Collect the emmeans for richness data
emms.richness001 <- as.data.frame(model.richness001.em$emmeans)
emms.richness001$metric <- "Richness (> 0.01)"

# Set colourblind-conscious palette
# These colours are part of the farbenblind_muted_10 palette (https://msk678.github.io/Farbenblind.html)

mia_palette <- c("#117733","#999933","#DDCC77","#CC6677")

# Plot the Shannon data
p.shannon <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = emms.shannon,
           aes(x = treatment, y = response, fill = treatment),
           stat = "identity",
           colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(data = emms.shannon,
                aes(x = treatment, ymin = response-SE, ymax = response+SE),
                stat = "identity", width = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(data = richness,
              aes(x = treatment, y = Shannon),
              width = 0.15, size = 1.25) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales="free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mia_palette) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color="black")) +
  scale_y_continuous(lim=c(0,2.4), breaks=c(0.0,0.6,1.2,1.8,2.4)) + 
  xlab("") + ylab("")

# Plot the richness data
p.richness <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = emms.richness001,
           aes(x = treatment, y = response, fill = treatment),
           stat = "identity",
           colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(data = emms.richness001,
                aes(x = treatment, ymin = response-SE, ymax = response+SE),
                stat = "identity", width = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(data = richness,
              aes(x = treatment, y = Richness_001),
              width = 0.15, size = 1.25) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales="free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mia_palette) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17), legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color="black")) +
  scale_y_continuous(lim=c(0,16), breaks=c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16)) + 
  xlab("") + ylab("")

```

## Calculate beta diversity

```{r Capscale analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Calculate the bray curtis distances
dist_bc <- phyloseq::distance(ps.rel, method = "bray")

# Extract sample data
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps.rel))

# Set the formula for the model
class(fo <- dist_bc ~ meta$Treatment + meta$Replicate + meta$Read_count)

# Run the capscale analysis followed by an ANOVA
pso_cap <- ordinate(ps.rel, "CAP", "bray", formula=fo)
anova(pso_cap, by = "margin", type = 2)

# Get the relative eigenvalues
all_eig <- eigenvals(pso_cap)
rel_eig <- all_eig / sum(all_eig)
var_explained <- round(rel_eig * 100, 1)

```

## Make capscale ordination plot and combine with a-div plots

```{r}

# Plot capscale results
treatment_colours <- setNames(mia_palette[1:4], c("Standard", "Control", "bsPVC", "fPVC"))
ordplot5 <- plot_ordination(ps.rel, pso_cap,
                           type = "samples",
                           axes = c(1, 2))
p.beta.cap <- ordplot5 +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Treatment, shape = Replicate),
             size = 7,
             colour = "black",
             stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Treatment",
                    values = treatment_colours,
                    breaks = c("Standard", "Control", "bsPVC", "fPVC"),
                    drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 24)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    shape = 21,
    colour = "black",
    fill = unname(treatment_colours[
      c("Standard", "Control", "bsPVC", "fPVC")
    ])
  ))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 17),
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right") +
  labs(x = paste0("CAP 1 [", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%]"),
       y = paste0("CAP 2 [", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%]")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.50, 1.50),
                     breaks = c(-1.50, -0.75, 0, 0.75, 1.50),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.50, 1.50),
                     breaks = c(-1.50, -0.75, 0, 0.75, 1.50),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x))

# Combine plots
p.shannon + p.richness + p.beta.cap

```

## Differential MAG abundance analysis to see if any MAGs are enriched on bsPVC or fPVC compared to both standard and control

```{r MAG differential abundance analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Set the factors to get standard as the reference
sample_data(ps)$Treatment <- factor(sample_data(ps)$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c("Standard", "Control",
                                               "bsPVC","fPVC"))

# Run ANCOMBC2 with standard as the reference
ancombc.standard <- ancombc2(data = ps,
                             fix_formula = "Treatment", 
                             rand_formula = "(1 | Replicate)",
                             p_adj_method = "BH",
                             alpha = 0.025,
                             global = FALSE)
ancombc.standard.res <- ancombc.standard$res

# Set the factors to get control as the reference
sample_data(ps)$Treatment <- factor(sample_data(ps)$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c("Control", "Standard",
                                               "bsPVC","fPVC"))

# Run ANCOMBC2 with control as the reference
ancombc.control <- ancombc2(data = ps,
                               fix_formula = "Treatment", 
                               rand_formula = "(1 | Replicate)",
                               p_adj_method = "BH",
                               alpha = 0.025,
                               global = FALSE)
ancombc.control.res <- ancombc.control$res

# Get differentially abundant taxa for bsPVC
taxa.diff_abn.bsPVC = data.frame()
for(n in 1:nrow(ancombc.standard.res)) { 
  if(ancombc.standard.res$diff_TreatmentbsPVC[n] == TRUE & 
     ancombc.standard.res$passed_ss_TreatmentbsPVC[n] == TRUE &
     ancombc.control.res$diff_TreatmentbsPVC[n] == TRUE & 
     ancombc.control.res$passed_ss_TreatmentbsPVC[n] == TRUE) { 
    taxa.diff_abn.bsPVC <- rbind(taxa.diff_abn.bsPVC, ancombc.standard.res$taxon[n])
  }
}

# Print the results for bsPVC
if(nrow(taxa.diff_abn.bsPVC) == 0) {
  print("No MAGs met the criteria for differential abundance for bsPVC")
} else {
  print(taxa.diff_abn.bsPVC)
}

# Get differentialy abundant taxa for fPVC
taxa.diff_abn.fPVC = data.frame()
for(n in 1:nrow(ancombc.standard.res)) { 
  if(ancombc.standard.res$diff_TreatmentfPVC[n] == TRUE & 
     ancombc.standard.res$passed_ss_TreatmentfPVC[n] == TRUE &
     ancombc.control.res$diff_TreatmentfPVC[n] == TRUE & 
     ancombc.control.res$passed_ss_TreatmentfPVC[n] == TRUE) { 
    taxa.diff_abn.fPVC <- rbind(taxa.diff_abn.fPVC, ancombc.standard.res$taxon[n])
  }
}

# Print the results for fPVC
if(nrow(taxa.diff_abn.fPVC) == 0) {
  print("No MAGs met the criteria for differential abundance for fPVC")
} else {
  print(taxa.diff_abn.fPVC)
}

```

## Summarize data at the species level and test whether any species are enriched in bsPVC or fPVC samples compared to both standard and control

```{r Differential abundance analysis at the species level, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

                                            levels = c("Standard", "Control",
                                                       "bsPVC","fPVC"))

                             fix_formula = "Treatment",

} else {

}
```

## Make stacked barplots

```{r}

# Convert abundance data to percentages and create dataframe
ps.percent <- transform_sample_counts(ps.rel, function(x) x * 100)

df.plot <- psmelt(ps.percent) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment,
      levels = c("Standard", "Control", "bsPVC", "fPVC")),
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    MAG = as.character(OTU)
  )

# Order samples by treatment and replicate
sample_order <- sample_data(ps.percent) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = rownames(.),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment,
      levels = c("Standard", "Control", "bsPVC", "fPVC"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Treatment, Replicate) %>%
  pull(Sample)

df.plot$Sample <- factor(df.plot$Sample, levels = sample_order)

# Group MAGs with abundance < 1% across replicates into "other"
mag_keep <- df.plot %>%
  group_by(MAG) %>%
  summarise(Max_abundance = max(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(Max_abundance >= 1) %>%
  pull(MAG)

df.plot <- df.plot %>%
  mutate(Taxon = ifelse(MAG %in% mag_keep, MAG, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Treatment, Taxon) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Make "other" last
taxa_levels <- c(sort(setdiff(unique(df.plot$Taxon), "Other")),
  if ("Other" %in% df.plot$Taxon) "Other")
df.plot$Taxon <- factor(df.plot$Taxon, levels = taxa_levels)

# Set colour palette
palette_taxa <- colorRampPalette(carto_pal(12, "Safe"))(26)

# Make stacked barplot
p.stacked <- ggplot(df.plot, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Taxon)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(~ Treatment, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette_taxa, name = "MAG") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 105)) +
  labs(x = " ", y = "Relative abundance (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines")
  )

p.stacked

```

## Plot abundance of MAG 70 (E. hormaechei) across treatments

```{r}

# Extract abundance of MAG 70 from ps.rel
abund70 <- psmelt(ps.rel)
mag_data <- subset(abund70, OTU == "Mealworm_MAG_0070")
mag_data$Abundance <- mag_data$Abundance * 100

# Set treatment order
mag_data$Treatment <- factor(
  mag_data$Treatment,
  levels = c("Standard", "Control", "bsPVC", "fPVC")
)
mag_data <- mag_data[order(mag_data$Treatment, mag_data$Sample), ]

mag_data$Sample <- factor(
  mag_data$Sample,
  levels = unique(mag_data$Sample)
)

# Make barplot
p.mag <- ggplot(
  mag_data,
  aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Treatment)
) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mia_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black")
  ) +
  xlab(" ") +
  ylab("Relative abundance (%)")

p.mag

```
